reviewed_by: Codex focused Butler semantic memory review
reason: Butler now selects durable memories with its model and saves them through a provenance-checked Core capability. Python memory tests cover the gateway, source validation, selected-project scope, persistence, and next-turn recall. The two touched UI component files cover an open Memory panel refreshing after a Butler turn and Voice delegation to the saved Butler session. Three selected production LAN real-Core cases cover model tool save, the visible Memory list, reload, and desktop/mobile browser behavior.
exclusions: No native tests or unrelated Python and UI modules changed. Full suites are excluded. Physical iPhone microphone and live GPT-Live/Codex model judgment are separate operator acceptance gates; the selected tests exercise the delegated chat path with a deterministic model stub.
